# Balance summary

<!-- Generated by `pnpm balance:summary`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Ruleset 25, 500 seeds per slot order, every
matchup (mirrors excluded). Regenerate after any change to a ball or the combat rules with
`pnpm balance:summary`.

Each group is a count of opponents, with the ball’s average win rate against them in brackets.
Three levels (ADR 0073): a strong counter wins 65% or more, an edge 58% up to 65%,
anything closer is even. **Map** groups opponents by the counter map’s labels, **Measured** by
the better side’s result in this run. **Gap** is strong wins minus strong losses (the shape counts
strong counters only); WARN marks a gap of 2 or more either way, a prompt to look rather
than a failure.

## The shape

Hard limits (ADR 0076): no ball has more than 6 strong wins or 6 strong losses, and every
ball added after ruleset 22 has at least 2 of each.

The shape is a warning: 2-4 strong counters each way, the two counts within 1; a fifth on one
side where one visible mechanic gives it: Bloom (losses: any hit shuts the bud). The even pick has exactly its
counters: Brawler beats nobody and loses to Thorns.
